mainEntity.name: How do we get employees to participate in a corporate wellness program?

acceptedAnswer.text: Encouraging employee participation requires clear communication, incentives, and management support. Promote the program widely, highlight its benefits, and make it easily accessible. Offering a variety of activities, including virtual and in-person options, can also increase engagement. A key process clarity point is integrating the wellness program into the company culture by having leadership visibly participate and endorse it, demonstrating its value and making it a shared priority rather than just an optional perk.
acceptedAnswer.description: Boost participation through clear communication, incentives, management support, and accessibility. Integrating wellness into company culture and leadership participation makes it a shared priority.
